## alerts — notify the user

Does: Shows an alert to the user and records it in the activity log.
Needs: Nothing.

Calls on `IAlerts`:
- `void Raise(string message, AlertSeverity severity = AlertSeverity.Info, string? dedupeKey = null)` — Raises an alert; repeats with the same `dedupeKey` are collapsed.

Types:
- `AlertSeverity: Info | Warning | Critical` — How loudly an alert is shown.

Limits: Messages over 512 characters are cut. Alerts with the same dedupeKey shown close together are collapsed, so pass one for anything that can fire repeatedly.
